name: louvain
author: 91f2b762
description: Detects communities (groups of densely connected nodes) by maximising modularity with the Louvain algorithm. Use for questions like 'what are the communities in this network?', 'which group does X belong to?' or 'how strong is the community structure?'. Works on undirected graphs, weighted or not; directed graphs are also accepted but edge directions are ignored. Returns the modularity score (higher means stronger communities), the number of communities, and the top_k largest communities, each with its size, a sample of member nodes (id and label) and a graph_id of a registered subgraph that other tools can analyse; result_graph_id is the largest community. Optionally pass node to also get that node's community. Deterministic for a given seed.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'karate' or 'lesmis'.

top_k.description: How many of the largest communities to return.

seed.description: Seed for the random node order; the same seed always gives the same communities.

resolution.description: Modularity resolution: values above 1 give more, smaller communities; below 1 fewer, larger ones. Must be greater than 0.

use_weights.description: Use edge weights as connection strength (only if the graph is weighted). Set false to count every edge as 1, e.g. for 'airports', whose weights are distances in km.

node.description: Optional node id: also return which community this node belongs to. Use lookup_node to find it from a name.
